items.title: AI-synthesized faces are indistinguishable from real faces and more trustworthy

judge.evidence_empirical: Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces.
judge.evidence_topic: Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces.
judge.reason: O artigo trata diretamente da percepção humana de rostos sintéticos, com avaliação empírica mencionada no resumo, o método extraído é compatível e o achado principal é exatamente o declarado no resumo.

items.title: Deepfake detection by human crowds, machines, and machine-informed crowds

judge.evidence_empirical: In two online studies with 15,016 participants, we present authentic videos and deepfakes and ask participants to identify which is which.
judge.evidence_topic: How can we know whether a video that we watch is real or fake? In two online studies with 15,016 participants, we present authentic videos and deepfakes and ask participants to identify which is which.
judge.reason: Artigo com estudos online em que participantes humanos detectam deepfakes em vídeo, comparando desempenho com modelo de visão computacional. O método e o tipo de estudo extraídos batem com o resumo, e o achado principal está plenamente respaldado pelo trecho citado.

items.title: Warning: Humans cannot reliably detect speech deepfakes

judge.evidence_empirical: We presented genuine and deepfake audio to n = 529 individuals and asked them to identify the deepfakes.
judge.evidence_topic: Speech deepfakes are artificial voices generated by machine learning models. ... We presented genuine and deepfake audio to n = 529 individuals and asked them to identify the deepfakes.
judge.reason: O achado principal é inteiramente sustentado pelo resumo, que afirma que a capacidade de detecção não é confiável, com 73% de acertos e sem diferença entre línguas.

items.title: Fooled twice: People cannot detect deepfakes but think they can

judge.evidence_empirical: O resumo afirma: "In a pre-registered behavioral experiment ( N = 210)"
judge.evidence_topic: O resumo menciona deepfakes e o desafio de verificar a veracidade de conteúdo online, indicando que o estudo investiga a detecção desses conteúdos por pessoas.
judge.reason: O achado é totalmente sustentado pelo resumo: as pessoas não detectam deepfakes de forma confiável ("people cannot reliably detect deepfakes"), tendem a julgá-los autênticos ("biased towards mistaking deepfakes as authentic") e superestimam a própria capacidade ("overestimate their own detection abilities").

items.title: Providing detection strategies to improve human detection of deepfakes: An experimental study

judge.evidence_empirical: In this preregistered online experiment, participants (N = 454, Mage = 37.19, SDage = 13.25, males = 57.5%) categorize a series of 20 videos as either real or deepfake.
judge.evidence_topic: participants (N = 454) ... categorize a series of 20 videos as either real or deepfake.
judge.reason: O artigo trata de percepção/detecção humana de deepfakes, é um experimento com participantes humanos, o método e o tipo de estudo extraídos batem com o resumo, e o achado principal é diretamente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: People are poorly equipped to detect AI-powered voice clones

judge.evidence_empirical: Through a series of perceptual studies, we report on the realism of AI-generated voices in terms of identity matching and naturalness.
judge.evidence_topic: We find human participants cannot consistently identify recordings of AI-generated voices.
judge.reason: O artigo investiga a capacidade humana de identificar vozes sintéticas geradas por IA, tema central do pedido. É um estudo empírico com participantes humanos (estudos perceptuais). O método descrito nos dados extraídos corresponde ao resumo. O achado principal de que humanos não identificam consistentemente vozes de IA e frequentemente atribuem a elas a mesma identidade que a voz real é plenamente apoiado pelo resumo.

items.title: Deepfake detection with and without content warnings

judge.evidence_empirical: We conduct an experiment to measure people's alertness to and ability to detect a high-quality deepfake among a set of videos.
judge.evidence_topic: deepfake video technology-which uses deep learning artificial intelligence algorithms to create fake videos that look real; people's alertness to and ability to detect a high-quality deepfake among a set of videos.
judge.reason: O achado principal reproduz exatamente os dois resultados descritos no resumo: sem aviso, não houve diferença na detecção em relação ao controle (32.9% vs 34.1%); com aviso, apenas 21.6% identificaram corretamente o deepfake como o único vídeo inautêntico.

items.title: AI Hyperrealism: Why AI Faces Are Perceived as More Real Than Human Ones

judge.evidence_empirical: In Experiment 1 ( N = 124 adults) ... In Experiment 2 ( N = 610 adults)
judge.evidence_topic: White AI faces are judged as human more often than actual human faces—a phenomenon we term AI hyperrealism.
judge.reason: O estudo aborda diretamente a percepção de rostos gerados por IA (deepfakes/rostos sintéticos), com dois experimentos empíricos com participantes humanos. O método descrito nos dados extraídos concorda exatamente com o resumo. O achado principal de que rostos brancos de IA são julgados como humanos mais frequentemente do que rostos reais (hiper-realismo) está claramente apoiado pelo resumo: 'White AI faces are judged as human more often than actual human faces'. Portanto, todos os critérios são atendidos.

items.title: Are you for real? Decoding realistic AI-generated faces from neural activity
Voice clones sound realistic but not (yet) hyperrealistic

judge.evidence_empirical: We investigated the extent to which AI-generated voices sound real to human listeners, and whether listeners can accurately distinguish between human and AI-generated voices.
judge.evidence_topic: We investigated the extent to which AI-generated voices sound real to human listeners, and whether listeners can accurately distinguish between human and AI-generated voices. We also examined perceived social trait characteristics (trustworthiness and dominance) of human and AI-generated voices.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com ouvintes humanos sobre percepção de vozes sintéticas. O método extraído ('Ouvintes avaliaram realismo e traços sociais...') confere com o resumo. O achado principal é respaldado diretamente pelo resumo.

items.title: Training human super-recognizers' detection and discrimination of AI-generated faces

judge.evidence_empirical: In two different experimental designs, we found that SRs (total N = 283) were better at detecting and discriminating synthetic faces than controls (total N = 381)
judge.evidence_topic: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) can create realistic synthetic faces ... investigate synthetic face detection and discrimination in super-recognizers
judge.reason: O artigo aborda a detecção humana de rostos sintéticos gerados por IA, está dentro do tema e do recorte. Trata-se de estudo empírico com participantes humanos (dois experimentos). O método extraído está em conformidade com o resumo. O achado principal é plenamente sustentado pelo resumo, que relata melhor desempenho dos super-reconhecedores e efeito positivo do treino em ambos os grupos.

items.title: What you see is not what you get anymore: a mixed-methods approach on human perception of AI-generated images

judge.evidence_empirical: A total of 104 participants took part in an online survey, classifying 50 images (25 real, 25 AI-generated) from five leading TTI models.
judge.evidence_topic: This study explores human perception and detection capabilities regarding AI-generated images of landscapes, architecture, and interiors
judge.reason: O artigo está no tema, pois investiga a percepção humana de imagens sintéticas (IA), sem foco político, e se baseia em dados empíricos de um survey online com 104 participantes, conforme o resumo. O método extraído está correto e o achado principal (taxa de detecção de 63,7% e questões de calibração) é sustentado pelo resumo.
